Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest SOC 2 Type II & bridge clarification

Hi Rachel,

We're preparing Acme's security intake for procurement and the vendor team flagged that the SOC 2 report we have on file for Redwood is dated 2025-06-30. Our policy requires a Type II report covering the most recent 12 months or a bridge letter that demonstrates continuous coverage into the current year.

Can you confirm whether Redwood has: 
- a reissued Type II report covering through 2026-06-30 (or similar), OR
- an official bridge letter that covers 2026 (dates and scope)?

Our intake team is specifically worried about the audit period: the copy we saw shows an audit period ending 2025-06-30, which appears expired for our controls baseline. If there was a reissue with an updated cover page or a clarifying addendum, please point us to the exact document.

Thanks — quick turnaround appreciated; we need to close this before our contract review next week.

Best,
John Patel
Vendor Risk Analyst
Acme Analytics
security@acme-analytics.com

John — thanks for the note and for flagging the intake expectation. Short answer: we do not have a brand new Type II report dated 2026-06-30; however, we have a reissued 2025 Type II PDF (minor editorial reissue of cover and report date) and an official bridge letter that covers the gap through 2026-06-30.

I'm looping in Marissa (Legal) and Karthik (Security) — they can confirm the language and audit window. We'll attach the reissued PDF and the bridge letter here for your intake.

A couple quick points to help reconcile what you saw: 
- The original audit period for the report was 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30. We had a minor reissue (no control changes) to correct a typographical cover date; that reissue did not change the audit window.
- To provide continuous coverage past 2025-06-30 we issued a bridge letter on 2026-01-01 that documents the ongoing controls posture through 2026-06-30. That bridge is the intended artifact used by many customers for procurement when a calendar-year-aligned report isn't yet available.

I'm attaching both documents below. If your intake policy requires a specific cover language or a signed attestation, let us know and we can route to our compliance counsel for a tailored statement.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025-06-30.pdf] (reissued cover), [Attachment: SOC2_Bridge_2026-01-01_to_2026-06-30.pdf]
